label: Mining
description: Extraction of raw materials: phosphate rock (P source), iron ore or iron-bearing waste streams (Fe source), spodumene or brine (Li), and flake graphite (anode).

label: Beneficiation / Concentration
description: Physical upgrading: phosphate rock flotation/washing, iron ore concentration, graphite flotation. Less complex than NMC (no Ni, Co, Mn required).

label: Chemical Processing
description: Conversion to battery-grade intermediates: phosphate rock → H3PO4; iron source → FeSO4 or Fe(OH)3; Li2CO3 from spodumene or brine. FePO4 precipitated from FeSO4 + H3PO4.

label: Precursor Manufacturing
description: Production of iron phosphate (FePO4) precursor via wet-chemical precipitation or oxidation of ferrous phosphate. Alternative: direct use of iron oxalate. Precursor quality (particle size, morphology) determines final LFP properties.

label: CAM Manufacturing (LFP)
description: Solid-state calcination: FePO4 + Li2CO3 + carbon source → LiFePO4/C at ~650–750°C. Inert or reducing atmosphere. Carbon coating formed in situ. Milling to final PSD.

label: Anode Material Manufacturing
description: Spheronization and purification of natural graphite, or graphitization of petroleum coke. Same as NMC route.

label: Electrode Manufacturing
description: LFP cathode slurry (LFP + conductive carbon + PVDF + NMP), coating on Al foil, drying, calendering to ~2.3 g/cc. NMC uses water-based slurry option less common for LFP.

label: Cell Manufacturing
description: Winding or stacking, electrolyte filling, sealing, formation cycling. LFP formation protocol differs from NMC (different SEI chemistry).

label: Module Assembly
description: Module integration with busbars, thermal management, and housing.

label: Pack Manufacturing
description: Module-to-pack integration with BMS, cooling, and enclosure.

label: Application
description: End-use: stationary energy storage, commercial EVs, e-buses, or LFP-based EV platforms.

label: End-of-Life / Recycling
description: LFP recycling is economically more challenging than NMC (lower Co/Ni value). Direct recycling or relithiation routes under development. Current commercial recovery primarily for Li; Fe and P largely unrecovered.

label: Process Waste / Losses
description: Sink for all process losses and scrap.

label: Mining
description: Extraction of raw ores: spodumene (Li), nickel sulfide/laterite ore (Ni), copper-cobalt ore (Co, byproduct), manganese ore (Mn), and flake graphite (anode).

label: Beneficiation / Concentration
description: Physical upgrading of ore to concentrate: flotation (spodumene, graphite), crushing/screening (Ni, Mn), gravity separation. Large mass reduction step.

label: Chemical Processing
description: Conversion of concentrates to battery-grade chemicals: spodumene roasting + leaching to LiOH·H2O; Ni/Co/Mn to sulfate salts via HPAL, SX-EW, or refining circuits.

label: Precursor Manufacturing (PCAM)
description: Co-precipitation of Ni0.8Mn0.1Co0.1(OH)2 from mixed sulfate solution. Controlled pH, temperature, and atmosphere. Washed, filtered, dried.

label: CAM Manufacturing
description: Calcination of PCAM blended with LiOH·H2O at 700–900°C in O2 atmosphere. Results in NMC811 oxide powder. Sieving, coating if applicable.

label: Anode Material Manufacturing
description: Spheronization and purification of natural graphite flake, or graphitization of petroleum coke (synthetic graphite). Carbon coating optional.

label: Electrode Manufacturing
description: Slurry mixing (CAM/graphite + binder + conductive carbon + solvent), coating on Al/Cu foil, drying (NMP recovery), calendering to target density, slitting.

label: Cell Manufacturing
description: Electrode winding/stacking, can/pouch assembly, electrolyte filling, sealing, formation cycling (initial charge/discharge), grading.

label: Module Assembly
description: Cell-to-module: busbar welding, thermal interface material, module housing. Some formats skip this step (cell-to-pack).

label: Pack Manufacturing
description: Module-to-pack: BMS integration, cooling system, enclosure, HV connectors, safety hardware. Final pack testing.

label: Application
description: End-use: EV traction battery, stationary energy storage, or other. Defines the functional unit basis (kWh nameplate capacity).

label: End-of-Life / Recycling
description: Battery collection, dismantling, and material recovery. Hydrometallurgical (black mass leach) or direct recycling routes. Recovered materials re-enter supply chain at processing or precursor stage.

label: Process Waste / Losses
description: Sink for all process losses, scrap, and rejected material. Flows here carry is_loss: true.
